'''2009 Bespin Regionals Brandon Brist LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Brist]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
